CURRENT SCENE:
可是夹竹桃的毒很重，让他肚子很痛。他在地上躺着，觉得他快会死了。可是正好有别人找到他了，给了他一个像伞的植物，叫灵芝。他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好，不再生病了。他测量起来了，像星星的植物是毒，像伞的植物是药。

ITEMS:

[I340] 觉得【他】快会死了   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]累死了 — her note: delete他
  her past correction: [-他]一吃就生病了
  her past correction: [-他]吃了以后 — her note: redundant

[I341] 觉得他【快会】死了   correction: 快会 → 快要   strength: error
  checker's note: 快要 expresses an imminent result
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]
  her past correction: [-他]累死了 — her note: delete他
  her past correction: 他一看[+就]觉得担心

[I342] 可是正好有【别人】找到他了   correction: 别人 → 人   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 有人 is the usual existential expression here
  rule card (other_vs_additional, Vocabulary): 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this means an additional/another <noun>, so use 另外, not 别的.  Her terms: 别的, 另外
  her past correction: 因为[别的人→有人]正好在他的旁边 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
  her past correction: 一个人正好[找了→找到了]神农 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: [别的人→有两个人]正好在走路呢 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

[I343] 给了他一【个】像伞的植物   correction: 个 → 株   strength: error
  checker's note: 株 is the measure word for an individual plant
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 但是吃[+了]像伞一样的植物以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I344] 【不再生病】了   correction: 不再生病 → 肚子不痛   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: the stated symptom was stomach pain, not illness
  rule card (non_adjective_degree_patterns, Grammar): “病” and “生病” are not normal Adj., so do not use 很 or 不 directly with them. To show degree, use 病得很厉害 or 病得很重.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 病/生病 is not a normal Adj., so it cannot take 很 or 不; use 病得很<degree> to describe how serious the illness is.  Her terms: 病得很厉害, 病得很重, Adj.
  her past correction: 肚子[还没疼死了→就不疼了]
  her past correction: [然后，不病→就好了] — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  her past correction: [就疼死了→肚子/头就疼死了]

[I345] 他【测量起来了】   correction: 测量起来了 → 明白了   strength: error
  checker's note: 测量 does not mean realizing toxicity
  rule card (no_le_speaking_word, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): A speaking word that introduces quoted speech normally uses no particle, not 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <speaking word> introduces quoted speech, so use no 了.  Her terms: no了for speaking word introducing quoted speech, no 了for speaking word, no了for speaking word
  her past correction: 他问[-了] — her note: no了for speaking word introducing quoted speech
  her past correction: 他还[想起来→想得起来]
  her past correction: 她[一看这→一看到这样] — her note: 看look vs.看到see

[I346] 像星星的植物【是毒】   correction: 是毒 → 有毒   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 是毒 -> 有毒 (corrected 14/15 in train)
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 有的花[是毒→有毒]

[I347] 像伞的【植物】是药   correction: 植物 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [几棵植物→有的植物]可以是药
  her past correction: 但是吃[+了]像伞一样的植物以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [吃→吃了]像伞的植物以后 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: 他 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
Use 快要 for something that is about to happen: 快要死了.
It would be more natural to say 有人 here for an unspecified person who found him.
Use 株 as the measure word for one individual plant.
It would be clearer to say 肚子不痛了, because the symptom in the story is stomach pain.
测量 means “measure.” Use 明白了 when he realizes which plants are poisonous or medicine.
Use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant, not 是毒.
It would be more natural to delete 植物 here because it is already clear from the previous phrase.
